Giant Snake den at the reedbed of the east mere, off the wade. Dense reedbed by water with abundant prey and no competing hunter.

Fleshfly Swarm den at the marsh pond west of the strip. Stagnant water beside carrion; the flies gather more thickly inland.
Torchbug den at the reeds by the track-head cairn. Flowering fern and reed grow here.

Moon Adder den at the bank stair stones. A warm stone crevice in reeds near rats and eggs.
Giant Wasp den at a dead tree on the ridge above the bank. A nest hung in a dead tree at a clearing edge with prey crossing open ground.
Fellrunner den at fern on the bank top. A scrape under dense fern near farm fields that supply its seed.
